lines: Anupāya unit 4: Which fourfold-told form of awareness — of the pervading, this:
l4.sanskrit_cite: yaccaturdhoditaṃ rūpaṃ vijñānasya vibhorasau svabhāva eva mantavyaḥ sa hi nityodito vibhuḥ
